data.description:
## Context / Problem

Pass 1 (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py`, `passes.pass1_chunk`, prompts `reviewers/plan_review_finder.md` + one `plan_review_<ID>.md` per criterion, routing in `criteria_routing.json` + `.rebar/criteria_routing.json`, frontier class = Opus on Bedrock) is the expensive pass (~$3.4/review uncached, ~12 finder calls). A criterion edit cannot be judged from stored data alone, so Tier 2 re-runs finders on a small fixed sample and then runs Tier 1 on the new findings so the whole chain is measured. Per-criterion edits are far cheaper in single-criterion mode (one single-turn call ≈ $0.17 at 30k Opus input), and prior work (`docs/experiments/plan-review-model-tradeoff.md`) showed Opus is flat to 12 criteria/turn while Sonnet degrades — which is why the production model must be used.

## Approach

Build `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/tier2.py`:

- **Fixed sample**: a committed list of ~20 review ids drawn once by the Tier-1 stratified sampler (with the additional stratum: at least 5 containers, at least 8 with ≥10 findings, at least 3 from the LMN store), stored as `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay/tier2-sample.json` so every proposal is measured on the same plans. Plan text comes from the reconstructed material; code-grounded AGENT criteria run against the pinned `verified_at_sha` snapshot via the existing `source=attested` mechanics.
- **Full mode**: run the candidate registry/prompts through `ProductionBatchRunner`/`run_pass1` with the frontier class pinned to Bedrock Opus; compare finding sets to the stored Pass-1 findings by `norm_id` (Jaccard, gained/lost per criterion), then run Tier 1 (current questions) on the candidate findings and Tier 0 downstream.
- **Single-criterion mode**: `--criteria T5c` runs only the named criteria (single-turn chunk of one, via the same seam `probe_criteria` uses) on the sample and compares only that criterion's findings; cost ≈ N × $0.17.
- The baseline for a criterion whose stored findings were produced under a different `regver` is a one-time baseline run recorded in the ledger; otherwise the stored findings are the baseline.
- Budget pre-flight from stored per-criterion usage (`coverage.usage.per_criterion`) × current price.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/tier2.py` (new)
- `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay/tier2-sample.json`, `tier2-*.md` (new/generated)
- `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_tier2.py` (new)

## Testing

Unit: with a `FakeRunner` returning canned `P1Output`, gained/lost findings per criterion match expectations; single-criterion mode issues exactly one chunk per sampled review containing only the requested criterion; a run is refused when the frontier model is not the Bedrock Opus id; the sample file is validated against the corpus manifest. Live (commissioning, ≤$60): one full-mode baseline over the fixed sample.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A committed fixed sample of review ids exists with the strata above; checked by the sample file and manifest cross-check.
- [ ] `tier2 --candidate <registry-dir>` produces finding-set Jaccard and gained/lost-per-criterion tables plus downstream Tier-1/Tier-0 metrics; checked by one generated report.
- [ ] `tier2 --criteria <id>` costs ≤ N × $0.25 in the ledger for a single-turn criterion; checked by the ledger.
- [ ] Commissioning spend for this ticket ≤ $60 and every call uses the Bedrock frontier model id; checked by the ledger.
- [ ] Unit tests pass in `make test`.
data.title: Tier-2 harness: replay Pass-1 criteria on a fixed stratified sample (Opus via Bedrock, budgeted; single-criterion mode)
